fact_text: The KSE-100 corrected on 21 Aug 2025 after touching about 151,000, following a run of straight sessions.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 21 August 2025 | KSE100 Correction & Dividend Stocks in Focus | PSO | APL | MEBL |' (YouTube, 2025-08-21)

fact_text: The index gained about 300 points in a few very straight sessions before the late-August correction.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 21 August 2025 | KSE100 Correction & Dividend Stocks in Focus | PSO | APL | MEBL |' (YouTube, 2025-08-21)

fact_text: Banking stocks led the 21 Aug 2025 correction, and Meezan Bank, which had risen sharply, also fell back; the analyst said its fundamentals remained sound.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 21 August 2025 | KSE100 Correction & Dividend Stocks in Focus | PSO | APL | MEBL |' (YouTube, 2025-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst expected profit-taking in the late-August rollover week, a period he said usually brings market pressure at month end.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 21 August 2025 | KSE100 Correction & Dividend Stocks in Focus | PSO | APL | MEBL |' (YouTube, 2025-08-21)

fact_text: Nestle Pakistan, Unilever Food Pakistan and Pakistan Tobacco were among the multinational index names that helped lift the KSE-100 earlier in the period.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 21 August 2025 | KSE100 Correction & Dividend Stocks in Focus | PSO | APL | MEBL |' (YouTube, 2025-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst said circular-debt-linked names such as PSO and PPL did not perform well, while dividend-yield stocks were seen as more resilient.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 21 August 2025 | KSE100 Correction & Dividend Stocks in Focus | PSO | APL | MEBL |' (YouTube, 2025-08-21)

fact_text: The analyst said circular-debt relief could follow a Pakistani official's China visit, with money going to IPPs, energy-sector firms or distribution companies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 21 August 2025 | KSE100 Correction & Dividend Stocks in Focus | PSO | APL | MEBL |' (YouTube, 2025-08-21)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer pays dividends in each of the four quarters, which the analyst cites as a reason it suits dividend-yield investors.

fact_text: Security Papers' 30 July 2025 results carried a dividend of Rs 9 per share, down from Rs 10 a year earlier.

fact_text: Millat Tractors pays large dividends when tractor sales are strong; unit sales were weak for about two years, and recovery would make it a dividend candidate.

fact_text: The Punjab government's Dream Tractor Scheme was aimed at lifting tractor sales, which the analyst linked to Millat Tractors' outlook.

fact_text: Pakistan Oilfields pays dividends twice a year and is a mature asset whose production profile is not expected to grow.

fact_text: Attock Petroleum is an oil marketing company with about a 10 percent share of volume handled in the OMC sector, operating stations across the country.
